content_en.prompt: A marble track has four rockers, each leaning left (position 0) or right (position 1). Hitting a rocker flips its position; a marble rolling right falls to the bottom, rolling left hits the next rocker.
content_en.question: All rockers are reset to 0. What will the rockers (bottom to top) read after ten marbles roll through?
content_en.explanation: The topmost rocker flips every marble, so after 10 (even) it's back to 0. The 2nd rocker flips only when the top was 1 (every other marble) — 5 times, ending at 1. The 3rd flips only every 4th marble (2 times in 10) ending at 0. The bottom flips only when all three above were 1 — once (at marble 8) — ending at 1. Final: 1,0,1,0.
content_en.ct_explanation: The rockers represent electronic circuit elements that toggle between two states — a variant of a flip-flop. Connected as half adders (taking a stored state plus an impulse, producing a new state plus carry), the rockers together form a binary counter: their final states represent the binary number 10 (ten marbles → 1010 in binary).

content_zh.prompt: 彈珠軌道上有四個翹翹板，每個都可能是靠左（狀態0）或靠右（狀態1）。彈珠撞到翹翹板時，翹翹板的狀態會翻轉；彈珠往右滾就會直接掉到底部，往左滾就會撞到下一個翹翹板。
content_zh.question: 所有翹翹板都重設為0，如果讓10顆彈珠依序滾過軌道，最後（從下往上讀）翹翹板的狀態會是什麼？
content_zh.explanation: 最上面的翹翹板每顆彈珠都會翻轉一次，10顆（偶數）之後會回到0。第二個翹翹板只有在上面那個是1的時候才會翻轉（每隔一次），10次裡翻轉5次，最後是1。第三個只有每第4顆彈珠才會翻轉，10次裡翻轉2次，最後是0。最底下的只有在上面三個都是1的時候才會翻轉，10次裡只發生1次（第8顆彈珠時），最後是1。所以最終狀態是1、0、1、0。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這些翹翹板其實代表的是「在兩個狀態之間切換」的電子電路元件——正是正反器(flip-flop)的一種變化型。這些翹翹板連接成「半加器」(接收目前儲存的狀態加上一個脈衝，輸出新狀態跟進位)，整組合起來就變成一個「二進位計數器」：最後的狀態剛好就是二進位的數字「10」（十顆彈珠→二進位1010）。
